title: nfp.json
description: Optional nf-ports settings for what detection cannot guess.

env.description: Extra environment. Templates: {url:<app name, package, directory, front or back>}, {branch}.

apps.description: Per app, keyed by its directory relative to the repository root.

portEnv.description: Variable the server listens on instead of PORT; nfp picks the port.

config.description: Playwright or Cypress config to use, relative to the repository root.

hiddenEnv.description: Variable the app reads to keep its window off screen; nfp e2e --hidden sets it to 1.
